sections.title: Output file parameters
items: Added output-file parameters derived from another command parameter.
Output filenames preserve regular and compound extensions while adding a dash-separated suffix.
Added validation for missing, self-referencing, and cyclic output-file sources.

sections.title: Command editor
items: Edit existing commands directly through JSON.
Switch between the manual editor and JSON editor without losing the current command.

sections.title: Enum values
items: Use separate machine keys and readable labels for enum choices.
Legacy string-list enums remain compatible and are normalized automatically.

sections.title: Reliability and readability
items: Improved command persistence across page reloads.
Increased interface font sizes and added the version indicator.
